info.name: Codex Caelestis — Traditional Astrology API
info.description:
Traditional (pre-1700) Western astrology calculation engine. Powered by Swiss Ephemeris.

## Setup
1. Sign up at https://traditional-astrology.com/signup.html
2. Start a free Practitioner trial (no card)
3. Go to your dashboard > API Keys > Create Key
4. Set the `X-API-Key` variable below to your key

## Differentiators
- Auditable rule ledger (every judgment cites Lilly, Bonatti, Ptolemy)
- ZR Longevity L1/L2 + Loosing of the Bond
- Traditional dignities, almuten, firdaria, profections
- Bulk PDF ZIP for Etsy/client automation

request.description:
Generate a complete traditional natal chart.

Returns:
- Planetary positions with dignity scores (exaltation, triplicity, term, face, detriment, fall, peregrine)
- Almuten figuris
- Sect (day/night birth)
- Firdaria sequence with dates
- Annual profection year and lord
- ZR Longevity L1/L2 indicators
- Loosing of the Bond
- Plain-language synthesis with source citations (Lilly, Bonatti, Ptolemy)

**Required plan**: Practitioner or Studio
